claims.statement: For every finite adaptive physical restriction tree of a centered Boolean function, with character recentering after every restriction, the folded-influence, phase and corrected-entropy decrements telescope exactly: J(root)-EJ(leaf)=sum_v pi_v D_v; P(root)-EP(leaf)=sum_v pi_v(L_v+W_v+R_v); F(root)-EF(leaf)=sum_v pi_v(B_v-W_v-S_v-R_v), where R_v,S_v are nonnegative.
claims.scope: All finite uniform-cube Boolean functions and finite adaptive trees of genuine physical coordinate-block restrictions; character recentering only.

dependencies.result: reflected tangent inequality, exact folded-influence drift, entropy restriction identity and block JS upper bound

claims.verification: analytic proof in REPORT.md; not independently reviewed

claims.statement: If derivative row i is relative-eta close to a coordinate subcube with trigger set F_i, then for A_i={i} union F_i, D_{A_i} >= [1+(1-2 eta)|F_i|] q_i.
claims.scope: Centered Boolean descendants satisfying the peer robust-row hypothesis, 0<=eta<1/2.

dependencies.result: q_k >= (1-2 eta) q_i for every trigger k in F_i
D_A=I_A+C_A is the exact one-step folded-influence decrement

claims.verification: analytic proof in REPORT.md; not independently reviewed

claims.statement: For the adaptive compiler that selects a relative-eta robust row i_v and restricts A_v={i_v} union F_{i_v}, sum_v pi_v [1+(1-2 eta)r_v] q_v <= J(root)-EJ(leaf) <= J(root). Hence sum_v pi_v r_v q_v <= J(root)/(1-2 eta); at eta=1/16 the coefficient is 8/7.
claims.scope: Any finite adaptive sequence of peer-certified robust rows; new robust rows may arise in descendants.

dependencies.result: local charge by actual physical decrement

claims.verification: analytic proof in REPORT.md; not independently reviewed

claims.statement: For the same sequential robust-row compiler, sum_v pi_v h2(q_v) <= C_eta J(root), with C_eta=max{(1+log2(1+eta)+1/ln2)/(2-2eta),1/(1-2eta)}. At eta=1/16, C_eta=1.3494175371409616...<1.35. Also sum_v pi_v q_v <= J(root)/(2(1-eta)).
claims.scope: Selected robust rows only; does not price all coordinates in each trigger block and does not cover nonrobust rows.

dependencies.result: dimension-free sum of codimension-weighted robust influences

claims.verification: analytic proof; constants from elementary scalar estimates; not independently reviewed

claims.statement: For the selected robust coordinate at each macro-step on the uniform cube, the account02/B12 net selector debit sums to at most [C_eta+1/((1-eta)ln2)]J(root); at eta=1/16 the coefficient is 2.8882922474225223....
claims.scope: Only the selected robust coordinate's one-coordinate selector debit; this does not separately price selector debits of all trigger coordinates in the same macro-block and does not cover nonrobust rows.

dependencies.result: sum of h2(q_v) and q_v for selected robust rows

claims.verification: conditional analytic corollary; not full block payment

claims.rejected_statement: At one fixed state, sum_i [1+(1-2 eta)r_i]q_i <= J over all relative-eta robust rows.
claims.counterexample_result: Exact AND_n family at eta=0 has q_i=2^{-(n-1)}, r_i=n-1 and left side=nJ, so no dimension-independent coefficient-one simultaneous sum can hold.
claims.scope: Refutes only the fixed-state simultaneous incidence sum, not the sequential physical compiler and not FEI.

remaining_obligation: Control nonrobust positive-defect rows or prove that a terminal critical core admits a robust/nonrobust first-entry decomposition whose retained S+R or signed co-pair/orientation credit pays the first nonrobust event. Full FEI remains open.
